name: 20291-decodeheavy-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. The engine core and the model worker run as two processes (`distributed-executor-backend: mp` in vllm-config.yaml), which is not what one GPU gets by default.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 4096 requests with a 1800 s safety cap -- ~3072 scored requests and ~1.6M scored output tokens, ~4 min.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, no tools: prompt 128 tokens mean (sd 32, clamped 32..256) against output 512 tokens mean (sd 64, clamped 256..640), so ~80% of the tokens moved are generated. Lengths are spread rather than pinned so the streams do not finish in lockstep and the resident batch stays near 512 all window. Greedy (temperature 0.0), `ignore_eos`, so every request emits exactly its sampled length.
purpose: A long-form story generator on one GPU, serving 512 concurrent users short prompts and lengthy eight-billion-parameter completions.
launch:
# Engine command line for 20291-decodeheavy-8b-1gpu.  Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml.
# max-num-seqs and max-num-batched-tokens are pinned because unpinned they resolve to 128 and
# 2048 through this entrypoint, well under the declared concurrency.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: mp
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
